question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.

observed_information.statement: A chef in black uniform stands behind a counter with rice, wasabi, and salmon while the right hand touches a rice mound.
A close-up shows hands on a wooden board with the left hand near rice and the right hand near a salmon slice.
A chef in black uniform shapes a piece of salmon nigiri sushi with both hands behind a wooden counter.
A close-up shows hands pressing rice onto a slice of salmon on a wooden cutting board.
A close-up shows hands holding a finished piece of salmon nigiri with the fish draped over the rice.
A person shapes rice with one hand and moves a salmon slice from the cutting board to an off-screen location with the other hand.
A chef holds chopsticks in the right hand and a white cloth in the left hand above the cutting board.
A chef places the white cloth down on the right side of the cutting board with the left hand.

working_relations.statement: v2 reports active nigiri shaping and a finished piece, while v1 reports hands near separate rice and salmon.
v1 reports a salmon slice near the right hand on the board, while v3 reports a salmon slice moving off-screen after rice shaping.
v2 reports rice being pressed onto salmon and a finished nigiri, while v3 reports only rice shaping and salmon handling.
v4 reports cloth and chopstick handling above the cutting board, while v1, v2, and v3 report rice and salmon manipulation.

unresolved_issues.issue: The relation between v4's cloth and chopstick handling and the rice/salmon states in v1-v3 remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v4's events do not report whether ingredients or a formed nigiri are present during the cloth handling.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether the salmon slice moved off-screen in v3 is the same salmon slice positioned near the right hand in v1 remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v3 does not report the salmon's destination and v1 does not report a continuous transfer.

unresolved_issues.issue: The transition from v1's separate rice and salmon positions to v2's pressing rice onto salmon remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: No supplied event reports the salmon slice being placed under the rice between those states.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether the rice piece shaped in v3 is the same piece pressed onto salmon in v2 remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: The events do not report piece identity or count across the shaping and pressing actions.

candidate_requests.observable: whether rice, wasabi, and salmon are arranged on the counter or board during v4's cloth handling as they are in v1.
candidate_requests.purpose: This would resolve U01 by connecting v4's cloth handling to the ingredient state shown in v1.

candidate_requests.observable: whether a pressed or finished salmon nigiri is visible on the board during v4's cloth placement.
candidate_requests.purpose: This would resolve U01 by connecting v4's cloth handling to the assembly state shown in v2.

candidate_requests.observable: whether the salmon slice moved off-screen in v3 appears at the right-hand salmon location in v1.
candidate_requests.purpose: This would resolve U02 by establishing or rejecting continuity of the salmon slice between v3 and v1.

candidate_requests.observable: whether v1's right-hand salmon slice becomes the salmon under rice in v2's pressing action.
candidate_requests.purpose: This would resolve U03 by supplying the missing transition between separate ingredients and pressing rice onto salmon.

candidate_requests.observable: whether the rice piece shaped in v3 is the same rice piece pressed onto salmon in v2.
candidate_requests.purpose: This would resolve U04 by establishing or rejecting continuity of the rice piece across shaping and pressing.
